skill: M05 号令群妖（狼妖精英）

parameters.prompt: The exact upright wolf warrior in the reference gives ONE commanding howl in place. From the resting pose it crouches slightly and draws both clawed hands back to its sides, then rears up, throws the head back with the muzzle pointing to the sky and the jaws open in a long howl, one clawed arm raised and pointing forward as a command, holds the howl for a moment, then lowers the arm and head and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. Both feet stay planted. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and two legs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Keep the same three-quarter left view, wolf head and ears, fur, armor and kilt. No jump, walking, turning, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: gather over the first second, the howl opens around one and a half seconds and is held to three seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
